propositions: Canonical contributor guidance hardcodes a specific bot identity (joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com) instead of instructing contributors to use their own configured git identity

AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and .agents/rules/rebar.md contain contradictory sign-off instructions: some prescribe Joe Oakhart's bot identity while policy requires contributors' real configured identities

A deterministic lint-integrated grep check must be added to fail the build if hardcoded personal sign-off references appear in contributor-facing documentation (AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, .agents/rules/*.md, docs/**/*.md) while excluding automation-owned paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/, docs/experiments/)
All contributor-facing guidance must be updated to explicitly reference the committer's own configured git identity (git config user.name/user.email) as the DCO sign-off source
